hooks.text: 图鉴规模超过 180 只怪物，每只还各有两种超稀有错版形态可收集。
hooks.excerpt: There’s 180+ monsters to add to your Kādodex, and each Kādomon has 2 super rare misprints to discover!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 怪物由主动、被动和 12 种属性共同定义，可把攻击联动成克制组合。
hooks.excerpt: All Kādomon have special characteristics, such as activated abilities, passive abilities and different typings (there’s 12 types in total!). Synergise your Kādomon’s attacks and create a super effective combo of monsters.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 完全进化后可用稀有道具突破极限，进入数值更强的第四阶 HYPER 形态。
hooks.excerpt: Once fully evolved, every Kādomon has the chance to get HYPER! Acquire very rare items that allow your Kādomon to break their limits and discover a hyper-powerful 4th form!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
